title: Feedback and suggestions

prompts.bug: Describe what you were trying to do and what actually happened.
prompts.feature: Describe the feature you want and the problem it would solve.
prompts.experience: What felt awkward? Other ideas are welcome too.
prompts.content: What's wrong with this song or lyrics source?

composeIntro: Describe the problem or idea, then preview before sending.
contactHint: Used only if a reply is needed, such as a Discord account or email.
previewIntro: Check the details below, then send.
diagnosticsAttached: The latest {count} event is attached | The latest {count} events are attached
fallbackIntro: If sending fails, save a file instead. Saved files are not sent; pass them to the developer yourself.
descriptionRequired: Briefly describe what happened to continue to the preview.

failure.expiredMessage: Create the preview again before sending.
failure.rateLimited: Too many reports were sent from this computer recently. Try again later.
failure.submitUnavailable: Sending is unavailable right now. You can save a file and pass it to the developer yourself.
failure.exportedMessage: The file was saved but not sent. Pass it to the developer yourself.
